summary: Reported s06:drivers/greybus/gb-beagleplay.c:204-214: peer hdr.size (le16) from the serdev/HDLC MCU peer is delivered to greybus_data_rcvd without cross-check against the locally known frame length (len = rx_buffer_len - 4, ignored); downstream gb_connection_recv re-reads msg_size from the same peer bytes (vacuous check); memcpy in gb_operation_create_incoming (operation.c:651) over-reads the fixed ~259-byte rx_buffer. Medium confidence; OOB read, destination bounded by hd->buffer_size_max.
